questions.question: What does the long vision beginning in Ezekiel 40 describe?
options: A great and shining city descending down out of heaven above
A new temple, measured by a man with a measuring reed
A wide valley full of very dry bones all coming back to life
A wide river of fire flowing out from the foot of the throne
questions.answer: A new temple, measured by a man with a measuring reed

questions.question: What did the man with the appearance of bronze use to measure?
options: A plumb line and a heavy stone
A scroll and a writer's full inkhorn
A linen cord and a measuring reed
A golden rod and a silver chain
questions.answer: A linen cord and a measuring reed

questions.question: Ezekiel was told to declare all he saw to the house of Israel.
He brought me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high _____.
The man measured the various _____ and chambers of the temple in detail.
